FkAd 是一款高效的系统级网络过滤与隐私防护工具。通过设备本地网络代理技术，一键帮助您过滤网页干扰元素与网络追踪，提供纯净、流畅的浏览体验。

核心功能：
- 一键防护：操作极简，只需一键即可开启或关闭系统级网络过滤。
- 自定义规则：高度自由，支持导入自定义过滤配置，完美兼容 GitHub 等社区主流开源规则。
- 全局网络净化：有效拦截网页中的恶意追踪器与弹窗干扰，提升网络访问流畅度。
- 极致性能优化：底层深度优化，即便加载海量规则库，依然保持超低内存占用与低功耗，运行稳定顺滑。
- 本地隐私保护：所有过滤均在设备本地完成。我们不收集、不记录、不上传您的任何网络数据，严格保障您的个人隐私。


FkAd is a highly efficient, system-level network filtering and privacy protection tool. Utilizing on-device local network proxy technology, it helps you filter out web interferences and network trackers with a single tap, providing a pure and smooth browsing experience.

Key Features:
- One-Tap Protection: Extremely user-friendly. Enable or disable system-wide network filtering with just one tap.
- Custom Rules: Highly customizable. Supports importing your own filtering configurations and is fully compatible with mainstream open-source rule sets from communities like GitHub.
- Global Network Purification: Effectively intercepts malicious trackers and pop-up interferences on web pages, enhancing network smoothness and speed.
- Ultimate Performance: Deeply optimized at the core level. Even when loading massive rule databases, it maintains ultra-low memory usage and minimal power consumption, ensuring stable and fluid operation.
- Local Privacy Protection: All filtering is executed locally on your device. We do not collect, log, or upload any of your network data, strictly safeguarding your personal privacy.




本应用不涉及用户注册或登录，所有功能开箱即用。为便于您验证核心的本地网络过滤与隐私防护功能，请按以下步骤测试：

【测试步骤】

1. 首次打开 App 时，系统会提示允许创建本地网络配置，请点击“允许”。

2. 复制测试规则链接：https://api.mdavid.cn/fkad?auth=dw323428
   在 App 中粘贴该链接，并点击“下载并导入”。

3. 点击主界面开关开启防护。
   打开 Safari 浏览器访问任意网页（如 www.baidu.com），验证网络请求过滤与隐私防护功能是否正常运行。

4. 返回 App 关闭开关，网络恢复默认状态。

【技术说明】
本应用基于 iOS 官方网络扩展框架（NEPacketTunnelProvider）进行本地代理开发，所有过滤逻辑均在设备本地完成，不依赖外部任何远程服务器，亦不收集或上传任何用户数据。


This app requires no account registration or login. All features are fully available upon launch. To verify local network filtering and privacy protection, please follow these steps:

【Testing Steps】

1. Launch the app for the first time. When prompted to create a local network configuration, tap "Allow".

2. Copy the test configuration URL: https://api.mdavid.cn/fkad?auth=dw323428
   Paste the URL into the app and tap "Download & Import".

3. Toggle the main switch on to enable protection.
   Launch Safari and visit any website (e.g., www.baidu.com) to verify network request filtering and privacy protection.

4. Return to the app and toggle the switch off to restore default network settings.

【Technical Details】
Powered by the official iOS Network Extension framework (NEPacketTunnelProvider), all filtering logic runs strictly on the local device. It operates without external remote servers and collects no user data.
